title: Planar nonlinear dynamics of a hanging geometrically exact beam with a moving mass
publisher: Elsevier, International Journal of Solids and Structures, Volume 325 (2026)
author: Kush Kumar; Shakti S. Gupta
locator: Abstract and conclusions: Lagrangian formulation for a geometrically exact beam with a moving mass; moving coordinate and nonlinear finite-element solution
notes: A recent geometrically exact beam study; its prescribed motion and hanging-beam configuration differ from the present gantry carriage model. Used as a methodological reference only.
